bio.jane/contract.question: Which of these molecules contain this SMARTS substructure?

description: Which of a list of small molecules contain a SMARTS substructure, with RDKit's substructure library (pattern-fingerprint screen, then atom matching). Returns the 0-based indices of the hits and of any structure RDKit could not read.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

molecules.description: the library: one SMILES or molfile per entry.

smarts.description: the substructure, as SMARTS (a plain SMILES reads as one).

name: search_molecule_library

hits.description: 0-based indices of the molecules that contain the pattern, ascending

summary.description: how many structures contain the pattern, of how many searched

unread.description: 0-based indices of the entries RDKit could not read, never searched
